items.title: Henry "Jack" Palmer Interview
items.q: Oh, yes. He wouldn't like Lonnie, he could play it all. Lonnie played a little piano, you know.

ctx.x: Way to, way to, I got water in the fridge to do.

And, you know, I just, I like Lonnie Johnson, his brother, Sturdy Roll. Sturdy Roll, yes. Sturdy Roll, yes. Yeah.
